name: Monkey puzzles and their kin
notes: The Araucaria trees of Gondwana: monkey puzzle of the Andes, Paraná pine of Brazil, bunya of Queensland, Norfolk Island pine, and the Cook pine — dinosaur-age conifers with armoured leaves and huge cones. Landmark trees; bunya nuts fed gatherings.

emergent.name: Kauri
emergent.source: Northland, New Zealand; vast grey columns; the same family. Kew POWO.

traits.trunk: towering straight bole, buttressed base, crown above the canopy
traits.note: leaf/trunk/petiole derived from the plant's shape class; per-species detail where the entry carries it (aroids, cannabis)

bark.notes: smooth grey-blue-mauve bark shedding in thick hammer-marked flakes, leaving a mottled patchwork of grey, cream and rust; huge resin drips

leaf.notes: thick leathery oblong to lance leaves, blunt, parallel-veined; bronze-red juvenile foliage; dull mid green adult

flower.form: cylindrical tan pollen cones 2-5 cm; round green female cones

fruit.form: round green cones 5-7 cm ripening brown, disintegrate on the tree

appearance.silhouette: a colossal grey untapered column bare for 20 m, then a massive rounded broad crown of thick radiating limbs; a forest cathedral pillar
appearance.refs: Wikipedia Agathis australis; NZ Plant Conservation Network; Kew POWO

canopy.name: Monkey puzzle
canopy.source: Chilean and Argentine Andes on volcanic ash; sacred to the Mapuche; 1,000 years. Kew POWO.

traits.native_range: Chilean and Argentine Andes on volcanic ash
traits.leaf_shape: compound or lobed leaves in a flat spreading crown
traits.trunk: single trunk, flat-topped crown or, for herbs, a huge single leaf on a stalk
traits.note: leaf/trunk/petiole derived from the plant's shape class; per-species detail where the entry carries it (aroids, cannabis)

bark.notes: grey-brown bark in horizontal ridged rings and wrinkles (like elephant hide), old leaf scars persisting; resin-crusted

leaf.notes: thick, stiff, glossy triangular scale leaves with a sharp spine tip, overlapping spirally to sheath the whole branch like reptile scales

flower.form: long cylindrical tan pollen cones; round spiky female cones

fruit.form: big round cones 10-18 cm, green then brown, shatter; large edible nuts

appearance.silhouette: straight trunk with whorls of rope-like, upcurved snakey branches; young trees a full pyramid, old trees a bare pole with a flat-topped umbrella of tufts
appearance.refs: Wikipedia Araucaria araucana; Kew POWO; Gymnosperm Database

canopy.name: Paraná pine
canopy.source: S Brazilian highlands; candelabra crown; pine-nut forests. Kew POWO.

traits.leaf_shape: compound or lobed leaves in a flat spreading crown
traits.trunk: single trunk, flat-topped crown or, for herbs, a huge single leaf on a stalk
traits.note: leaf/trunk/petiole derived from the plant's shape class; per-species detail where the entry carries it (aroids, cannabis)

bark.notes: thick dark grey-brown to red-brown bark, scaly and shallowly furrowed, flaking in thin plates; resinous

leaf.notes: narrow stiff lance-shaped scale leaves, sharp-tipped, dark green, spiralling densely round the branch tips

flower.form: cylindrical tan pollen cones; round female cones

fruit.form: big round cones 10-25 cm, green to brown, of large edible pinhao nuts

appearance.silhouette: the candelabra: tall bare trunk topped by a flat, wide umbrella of long upturned branches ending in tufts; unmistakable in the southern Brazilian highlands
appearance.refs: Wikipedia Araucaria angustifolia; Kew POWO; Gymnosperm Database

canopy.name: Bunya pine
canopy.source: Queensland; football-sized cones; the bunya feasts. Kew POWO.

traits.leaf_shape: compound or lobed leaves in a flat spreading crown
traits.trunk: single trunk, flat-topped crown or, for herbs, a huge single leaf on a stalk
traits.note: leaf/trunk/petiole derived from the plant's shape class; per-species detail where the entry carries it (aroids, cannabis)

bark.notes: dark brown to black-brown bark, thick, scaly and roughly furrowed, flaking in thin brittle scales

leaf.notes: glossy stiff lance-shaped leaves with a sharp point, in two flattened ranks along the shoot; dark green

flower.form: long cylindrical pollen cones; massive round female cones

fruit.form: football-sized green cones 20-35 cm, up to 10 kg, drop whole; large edible nuts

appearance.silhouette: tall straight trunk with a dome or egg-shaped crown of layered horizontal tufted branches; from afar a dark symmetrical dome with a lumpy outline
appearance.refs: Wikipedia Araucaria bidwillii; Kew POWO; Gymnosperm Database

canopy.name: Norfolk Island pine
canopy.source: Norfolk Island coasts; tiered symmetrical whorls. Kew POWO.

traits.leaf_shape: needles or scale leaves, evergreen (larch deciduous)
traits.trunk: single straight trunk, whorled branches, conical crown
traits.note: leaf/trunk/petiole derived from the plant's shape class; per-species detail where the entry carries it (aroids, cannabis)

bark.notes: grey-brown bark flaking in small thin scales; young trees smooth grey

leaf.notes: soft awl-shaped juvenile leaves in neat rows; adult scale leaves overlapping; bright green

flower.form: cylindrical tan pollen cones; round female cones

fruit.form: round cones 10-12 cm, green then brown, shatter

appearance.silhouette: perfectly symmetrical tiered spire: whorls of horizontal branches in evenly spaced storeys, each a flat fern-like plane; a giant Christmas tree 50 m tall
appearance.refs: Wikipedia Araucaria heterophylla; Kew POWO; Gymnosperm Database
